package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

func TestProjectAuthoringHandlersRejectBrowserSuppliedOwnershipTargetsAndRuntime(t *testing.T) {
	handler := ProjectAuthoringHandler{}
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	pathID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	flowID := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	key := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name, body string
		call       func(http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request)
		params     map[string]string
	}{
		{name: "student identity", body: `{"schema":"project-authoring-flow-create.v1","student_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"}`, call: handler.Create, params: map[string]string{"studentID": studentID, "pathID": pathID}},
		{name: "targets", body: `{"schema":"project-authoring-flow-create.v1","targets":[]}`, call: handler.Create, params: map[string]string{"studentID": studentID, "pathID": pathID}},
		{name: "runtime", body: `{"schema":"project-authoring-flow-create.v1","runtime_profile":"go-v1"}`, call: handler.Create, params: map[string]string{"studentID": studentID, "pathID": pathID}},
		{name: "course", body: `{"schema":"project-authoring-flow-create.v1","course_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"}`, call: handler.Create, params: map[string]string{"studentID": studentID, "pathID": pathID}},
		{name: "confirm extras", body: `{"schema":"project-authoring-flow-confirm.v1","approved_targets":[]}`, call: handler.Confirm, params: map[string]string{"studentID": studentID, "flowID": flowID}},
		{name: "publish runtime start", body: `{"schema":"project-authoring-flow-publish.v1","start":true}`, call: handler.RequestPublication, params: map[string]string{"studentID": studentID, "flowID": flowID}},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/", strings.NewReader(testCase.body))
			request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", key)
			route := chi.NewRouteContext()
			for name, value := range testCase.params {
				route.URLParams.Add(name, value)
			}
			request = request.WithContext(context.WithValue(request.Context(), chi.RouteCtxKey, route))
			writer := httptest.NewRecorder()
			testCase.call(writer, request)
			if writer.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || writer.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d headers=%v body=%s", writer.Code, writer.Header(), writer.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestProjectAuthoringProjectionUsesOnlyFrozenInputLocale(t *testing.T) {
	flow := domain.ProjectAuthoringFlow{Input: domain.ProjectAuthoringInputV1{Locale: "en"}}
	projection := projectAuthoringProjection(flow)
	if projection.Locale != "en" {
		t.Fatalf("locale=%q, want frozen input locale en", projection.Locale)
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(projection)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"preferred_language", "timezone", "student_id"} {
		if strings.Contains(string(encoded), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("projection leaked %q: %s", forbidden, encoded)
		}
	}
}

func TestProjectAuthoringCommandRequiresJSONAndCanonicalIdempotencyKey(t *testing.T) {
	handler := ProjectAuthoringHandler{}
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/", strings.NewReader(`{"schema":"project-authoring-flow-create.v1"}`))
	route := chi.NewRouteContext()
	route.URLParams.Add("studentID", "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	route.URLParams.Add("pathID", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")
	request = request.WithContext(context.WithValue(request.Context(), chi.RouteCtxKey, route))
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "text/plain")
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "not-a-uuid")
	writer := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.Create(writer, request)
	if writer.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", writer.Code, writer.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestProjectAuthoringCurrentRejectsQueryAndBody(t *testing.T) {
	handler := ProjectAuthoringHandler{}
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name, target, body string
	}{
		{name: "query", target: "/?locator=old"},
		{name: "empty query", target: "/?"},
		{name: "body", target: "/", body: `{}`},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, testCase.target, strings.NewReader(testCase.body))
			route := chi.NewRouteContext()
			route.URLParams.Add("studentID", "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
			route.URLParams.Add("pathID", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")
			request = request.WithContext(context.WithValue(request.Context(), chi.RouteCtxKey, route))
			writer := httptest.NewRecorder()
			handler.GetCurrent(writer, request)
			if writer.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || writer.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d headers=%v body=%s", writer.Code, writer.Header(), writer.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
}
